title: Sausage Balls
description: Three-ingredient breakfast bites of sausage, sharp cheddar, and biscuit mix, baked until browned and crisp at the edges.
story: Ryan Seacrest shared these on Live with Kelly and Ryan as his Christmas-morning breakfast. In our house they’re a breakfast food any time of year.
imageAlt: Small browned sausage balls with melted cheddar on a floral platter.
ingredients: 2 pounds raw breakfast sausage, such as Jimmy Dean
4 cups medium cheddar, freshly shredded from the block

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Break up the sausage in a large bowl. Add the cheddar, then the baking mix, and work it together with your hands just until it holds and no dry mix is left.
steps.why: Bagged shredded cheese is coated in starch so it won’t clump, and that starch keeps the mix from binding. Stop as soon as it comes together; working it longer makes the balls tough.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll the mixture into 1¼-inch balls and set them about an inch apart on the baking sheet.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Small balls are done sooner. Serve warm.
steps.why: The sausage is raw, so bake until the centers are no longer pink and reach 160°F.

notes.Use raw sausage: Smoked or precooked sausage won’t hold the balls together.
notes.Make ahead: Roll the balls and refrigerate them, covered, for up to a day before baking. To freeze, set the unbaked balls on a sheet until firm, then bag them. Bake from frozen and add 5 to 10 minutes.
notes.Yield: The original recipe doesn’t give one. Rolled at 1¼ inches, the batch makes about 4 dozen.
